scope: Theorem 2.4 (Minimum-enclosing-area inequality) of the manuscript “Boundary graph deformations for the spacetime Penrose inequality” (preprints/Boundary-graph-deformations-for-the-spacetime-Penrose-inequality-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4205f51d8f1b130b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 8. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (Ω, g, K) be an exterior as in Defini- tion 2.1. Assume Equations (2.1)–(2.3), integrability of µ and |J|g, and the finite ADM limits (2.4)–(2.5). Orient ∂Ω by the normal into Ω, and suppose θ+(∂Ω) ≤ 0. If E > |P|δ, then q E2 − |P|2 δ ≥ s ag(∂Ω) 16π . (2.10) No extension of the data across ∂Ω is required.
